specs.locator: p.1, Recommended Printing Settings › Drying Settings before Printing
specs.quote: Drying Settings before Printing Blast Drying Oven: 50 °C，8 h X1 Series Printer Heatbed: 60 - 70 °C, 12 h

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values; the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 31 ± 3 MPa, elongation 7.5 ± 1.3 %, bending modulus 2370 ± 150 MPa, bending strength 59 ± 6 MPa, impact 13.8 ± 0.9 kJ/m²) are not stored.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 2580 ± 220 MPa), melt index (23.2 ± 3.5 g/10 min at 210 °C, 2.16 kg), saturated water absorption (0.43 %), spool material and size (ABS, 200 × 67 mm), retraction, chamber temperature, overhang, bridging, humidity, support material.
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament.
